QF.id: XXVA Sales and Distribution of Research Services_6

question.text: Research reports must define the terms used in making recommendations and these terms shall be:

answer.text: Changed frequently to keep the reports fresh and innovative
Consistently used across all reports published by the analyst or entity
Different for each report depending on market conditions
Left undefined to allow reader interpretation

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 20 requires research analysts or entities to define the terms used in making recommendations (such as buy, hold, sell, or other rating conventions) and to use these terms consistently across reports. Pages 249-250 provide examples of such rating conventions. The Trap: Changing definitions or leaving terms undefined would defeat the consistency requirement and could mislead clients comparing reports over time. Note: Based on workbook pages 249-250 (rating conventions) and page 280 (Regulation 20 define-and-consistently-use requirement).
